science.title: Quantum ingenuity can sidestep limits of conventional chips—while using commercially accessible components
science.summary: For decades, computers have steadily grown faster and more powerful. Avik Dutt, an assistant professor of mechanical engineering at the University of Maryland, envisions another dramatic leap forward—one propelled by the quantum properties of light.

science.title: Laser light reveals where electrons accumulate in atomically thin semiconductor stacks
science.summary: Stacking semiconductors—the chips that power phones, computers and so much more—enables quicker signal movement with less energy, but how does the process actually work? Turns out shining a literal light on the semiconducting materials can help elucidate how the electrons move in the stack, according to a multi-institutional team in Japan. science.title: A fine-grained reconstruction of barley’s evolutionary history
science.summary: Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03494-1Chromosome-scale genome sequences from across the barley genus Hordeum reveal large structural variation, evidence of ancient genetic exchange and extensive divergence of regulatory sequences. These evolutionary processes have generated diversity that could be used to improve cultivated barley.

science.title: Quantum-enhanced sensing with 500 photons via Fock-space confocal focusing
science.summary: Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11353-2Quantum confocal microscopy enables deterministic preparation of high-photon-number Fock-like states with up to 500 photons, reducing photon-number variance by 21.5 dB and achieving record displacement-sensing precision 19.2 dB beyond the standard quantum limit.

science.title: Licensing mechanisms during RNA-guided DNA integration by type I-F3 CAST
science.summary: Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11287-9RNA-guided DNA integration by type I-F3 CRISPR-associated transposases (CASTs) is enhanced by redesigned TnsA and a holo complex whose coordinated conformational licensing reveals a conserved mechanistic framework for engineering highly active CASTs.

science.title: Augmenting reality with integrated photonics
science.summary: Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11146-7Integrated photonics could overcome key size, power and performance trade-offs in augmented-reality glasses, enabling compact, efficient displays while opening opportunities across quantum computing, bioimaging and optical sensing.
